_schema: SJGV v2.0 parameters. index-methodology.md is binding; current rationale is in docs/. Keys ending in _note or named ref/rule/why are documentation, not parameters.

objective.ref: Methodology §10. Diagnostic only; no risk statistic affects a weight.

risk.ref: Reporting only. AUD gold is the preferred regressor for AUD-cost companies.
risk.dimson_note: The ASX closes before the same-date XAUUSD daily bar. The lagged estimator addresses this non-synchronous trading; a USD fallback is flagged.

estimation_policy.rule: DERIVE OR FAIL. No field value may be invented.

permitted_provenance.sourced: read from a document, which the field cites by key
permitted_provenance.derived: computed from other SOURCED fields by an arithmetic identity or an explicitly stated formula — e.g. inferred = mr_total - M&I, net_debt = debt - cash, or the midpoint of a range the issuer itself published. The inputs must all be sourced and the formula recorded in the note.
permitted_provenance.bound: a conservative limit that runs AGAINST the name, stated as such. Not an estimate of the true value, a value the true one cannot be worse than.

forbidden: run-rate extrapolation into an undisclosed period
judgemental allocation of a multi-year programme
estimation_policy.on_absence: Remain absent; the engine reports, degrades or rejects according to the binding field rule.
estimation_policy.materiality_note: tools/sensitivity.py measures whether an unresolved reporting gap could move any final weight by more than 0.2 percentage points.

confidence_weights.ref: Methodology §6. Policy discounts for category confidence and development distance.
confidence_weights.hedge_horizon_note: Converts the disclosed 24-month forward-production share into ounces; sold ounces are removed from P&P first.

gates.capacity_note: Reported only: target positions are compared with five days at 20% of 90-session average daily traded volume.
gates.spread_note: Median daily regular-hours time-weighted quoted spread; p90 breach on a median pass is reported as strained.
gates.statement_age_note: Applied to the source behind every counted ledger category.

gate2.horizon_interval_note: Test a finite adverse upper edge; otherwise use the sourced lower edge and report at least AMBER.
gate2.capex_note: Deduct sourced non-deferrable commitments; do not assume discretionary growth continues.
gate2.anchor_note: The trailing real anchor is reporting-only; Gate 2 stresses current spot.
gate2.health_note: GREEN and AMBER qualify. RED exceeds the rescue or recovery boundary and is excluded.

execution_capital.ref: Methodology §3.2. Aggregate unfinished approved scopes before materiality; never spend down a carry-forward by assumption.

constraints.ref: Methodology §8. Caps bound discontinuous permanent-impairment exposure.
constraints.single_asset_note: Derived from sourced largest_asset_pp_share; absence is UNTESTED, never false.
constraints.guidance_delivery_note: Ratings are in data/guidance_delivery.json, claim evidence in knowledge/, and rationale in docs/guidance-delivery.md.

nav_model.ref: Methodology §9. Reporting only; no NAV output affects eligibility or weight.
nav_model.conservative_deck_note: The trailing three-year real AUD-gold average is the conservative reporting deck.
nav_model.non_reserve_note: Uses the ledger confidence weights and mines non-reserve material after reserves at the disclosed company production rate and AISC.
nav_model.limitations_note: Gold-only, one production rate and one AISC per company; excludes growth capital and the production it could buy.

rebalance.event_driven: corporate actions, jurisdictional events, Gate 1 or Gate 2 breaches — never deferred to the next cycle

reporting.ref: Methodology §10. Reporting does not affect weight.
reporting.asymmetry_note: tools/asymmetry.py reports piecewise beta and confidence intervals; it is not a backtest or weight input.
